environment.description: ECS Fargate task (platform version 1.4.0) with custom ImageMagick 6.9.11-60 build. Task role has no network-facing permissions. Container uses read-only root filesystem with tmpfs on /var/app/uploads (noexec,nosuid,size=50m). ImageMagick compiled with --without-modules flag and custom policy.xml that sets: (1) domain='coder' rights='none' pattern='*' followed by domain='coder' rights='read|write' pattern='{PNG,JPEG,GIF,PDF}', (2) domain='delegate' rights='none' pattern='*', (3) domain='path' rights='none' pattern='@*' to block @-file reads. Additionally, the task's awsvpc ENI is attached to a security group with ZERO egress rules (no outbound traffic permitted) and the subnet has no NAT gateway or internet gateway route. The Fargate platform's built-in seccomp profile (based on Docker default) blocks execve of arbitrary binaries but the subprocess calls to /usr/bin/convert and /usr/bin/exiftool are pre-allowed via a custom seccomp profile that whitelists only those two specific binary paths through a BPF filter on execve arguments.

config.imagemagick_policy_xml: <policymap><policy domain='coder' rights='none' pattern='*'/><policy domain='coder' rights='read|write' pattern='PNG'/><policy domain='coder' rights='read|write' pattern='JPEG'/><policy domain='coder' rights='read|write' pattern='GIF'/><policy domain='coder' rights='read|write' pattern='PDF'/><policy domain='delegate' rights='none' pattern='*'/><policy domain='path' rights='none' pattern='@*'/><policy domain='filter' rights='none' pattern='*'/></policymap>
config.network_security_group: sg-0x: ingress 443 from ALB only, egress NONE (0 rules)
config.subnet_routing: private subnet, no NAT gateway, no IGW route
config.seccomp_profile: custom: whitelist execve only for /usr/bin/convert and /usr/bin/exiftool absolute paths
config.task_role: arn:aws:iam::XXXX:role/docproc-task-minimal (no S3, no SSM, no network perms)
